defect: clk_i and its divided derivative are declared asynchronous
rationale: div_clk is generated from clk_i by the counter in the same design, so the two domains have a deterministic phase relationship. The asynchronous clock grouping removes valid timing analysis between related domains.

mutation.description: Added an asynchronous clock group between clk_i and the generated div_clk.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the even-divider counter and divided clock output; removed primitive wrappers, step-down control, and assertions.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: div_clk is a divided version of clk_i yet is placed in an asynchronous clock group with it.
